generation.prompt_exact:
Edit the PROVIDED OWN-GENERATED clean courtyard image into one seasonal production background. Output exactly1536x1024, fully OPAQUE. Preserve the exact existing composition, camera, architecture and contact geometry: warm buff plaster wall cap elevations, left shallow stone step, EMPTY narrow left soil inset and its curb, both empty side niches, closed narrow asymmetrical RIGHT wood gate, hinge and latch positions, wall-ground line and the paving seam layout. Preserve all these in place rather than redesigning the yard. Preserve broad clear pale paving for independent editable foreground sprites. No new geometry, furniture, pots, planters, plants, trees, vines, grass, birds, animals, feeders, baths, fountains, text, border, UI or objects. Keep soil empty. The sky/architecture/ground in this seasonal output are one flattened static foundation; no separate semantic layers implied. Match the supplied detailed naturalistic pixel art, stepped contours, controlled connected pixel shading and restrained low-contrast material detail. Keep birds the eventual focus and ground quiet. Retain soft upper-left light direction and stable ground contacts. This is a San Diego managed Mediterranean courtyard, whose seasonal differences are subtle light/moisture changes, not temperate forest phenology. Only change the following season-specific environment treatment; preserve source material identity and geometry.

SPRING: cool soft fresh daylight after the wet season, gentle pale marine-blue sky with restrained thin light clouds. Buff plaster slightly less warm, paving pale neutral stone with clean softly lit surfaces and just tiny residual darker seam hints, no puddles. Light is bright enough for birds against pale ground, gentle rather than dramatic. Do not grow any vegetation in the empty soil or cracks. No petals, leaf litter or props.
